steps.en: Hand the install page to the AI harness you already use and ask it to install
steps.zh: 把安装页交给你在用的 AI harness，让它来装
steps.code: Read https://ourlifeos.ai/install and install LifeOS for me.

steps.en: Detects your OS, harness, and config root — no path is assumed
steps.zh: 探测你的系统、harness 与配置根目录，不预设路径

steps.en: Copies the skill, runtime, and empty USER tree into the config root — additive, dry-run first
steps.zh: 把技能、运行时和空的 USER 树增补式复制进配置根目录，先 dry-run

steps.en: With your yes per step, merges the hooks and wires the lifeos launch command
steps.zh: 每步经你同意，合并 hooks 并接好 lifeos 启动命令

steps.en: Launch with the new command and ask for the onboarding interview
steps.zh: 用新命令启动，做一次入职访谈

steps.en: Captures your TELOS — goals, people, preferences — into your USER tree
steps.zh: 把你的 TELOS——目标、人际、偏好——收进 USER 树

steps.en: Every later turn loads your constitution and context; Pulse shows current → ideal state
steps.zh: 此后每轮加载你的宪法与上下文，Pulse 展示现状→理想状态

value.en: You stop re-explaining who you are: every AI session starts from your captured context instead of zero.
value.zh: 你不再每次重新自我介绍：每个 AI 会话从沉淀好的上下文出发，而不是从零开始。
